TSPEC001.Title: Unsupported specification entity
TSPEC001.Message: Entity '{0}' must be an accessible, closed, non-file-local class, struct, or interface

TSPEC002.Title: Unsupported specification property type
TSPEC002.Message: Property '{0}' has unsupported type '{1}'; expose a queryable scalar instead

TSPEC003.Title: Property cannot be read by generated code
TSPEC003.Message: Property '{0}' must be a readable, non-indexed property accessible from generated code

TSPEC004.Title: C# 14 is required
TSPEC004.Message: Generated specification extension properties require C# 14 or later

TSPEC005.Title: Property accessors must be generated
TSPEC005.Message: Use Selection.For<TEntity>() and generated properties; handwritten accessors cannot be translated safely

TSPEC006.Title: Incomplete specification
TSPEC006.Message: A selection cannot evaluate or compose predicates; build a comparison to obtain a Specification<TCandidate>

TSPEC007.Title: Redundant null check
TSPEC007.Message: Field '{0}' is a non-nullable value type

TSPEC008.Title: Object methods do not build rules
TSPEC008.Message: '{0}' does not build a specification; use field operators, EqualTo, In, or logical composition

TSPEC009.Title: Hidden properties are ambiguous
TSPEC009.Message: Property '{0}' hides another property; rename it or use an override

TSPEC010.Title: String is not portable to SQL
TSPEC010.Message: Specification strings must be valid Unicode without zero characters

TSPEC011.Title: Specification grammar is closed
TSPEC011.Message: '{0}' cannot derive from the closed framework types; compose specifications instead

TSPEC012.Title: Computed getter requires a persisted equivalent
TSPEC012.Message: Property '{0}' has a computed getter; map it only to a persisted column with identical values

TSPEC013.Title: Unsupported specification field operation
TSPEC013.Message: Operation '{0}' is not supported by this field; use the operations exposed by its generated type

TSPEC014.Title: Non-finite specification value
TSPEC014.Message: Specification floating-point values must be finite

TSPEC015.Title: Null string pattern
TSPEC015.Message: String matching requires a non-null pattern; use IsNull to test for null

TSPEC016.Title: Object tests do not build a rule
TSPEC016.Message: This expression inspects a specification object; use IsNull, IsNotNull, or EqualTo to build a rule

TSPEC017.Title: Specification evaluation requires a candidate
TSPEC017.Message: A specification cannot be used as a Boolean condition; call IsSatisfiedBy(candidate)

TSPEC018.Title: Property name conflicts with the selection API
TSPEC018.Message: Property '{0}' conflicts with a Selection or Object instance member; rename the model property or use a model with an equivalent differently named property
